task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Product' window in the iDempiere menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The iDempiere 'Product' window is open, showing fields like Search Key, Name, and Product Category.

task_completion.description: Search for and select the product 'Spade'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Product' window shows 'Spade' in the Name field or the record selection list.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Substitutes' tab within the Product window.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Substitutes' tab is selected and active at the bottom or top of the Product window interface.

task_completion.description: Create a new record and select 'Hoe' as the substitute product.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Substitutes tab, the 'Substitute Product' field is populated with 'Hoe'.

task_completion.description: Set the name of the substitution record to 'Alternative for Spring'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Name' field in the Substitutes tab contains the text 'Alternative for Spring'.

task_completion.description: Set the description to 'Suggest when Spade is out of stock'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Description' field in the Substitutes tab contains the text 'Suggest when Spade is out of stock'.

task_completion.description: Save the new product substitute record.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' icon is clicked, or a 'Record Saved' message appears, and the data remains visible in the fields.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The parent product is 'Spade'. The substitute product to be linked is 'Hoe'. The specific name for the substitution record must be 'Alternative for Spring' and the description must be 'Suggest when Spade is out of stock'. All actions must occur within the GardenWorld client context in iDempiere.
